5-6: A part of a number known: another part of the same number.
Parts of a whole taken away, by people or on the days of a walk: what is left of it.
Fractions compared by giving them one denominator: which is bigger, or how many lie between two.
A fraction spent, then a fraction of the rest: the amount at the start.
A jug full and partly full: the weight of the jug alone.
Two parts of a whole and the difference between them: the whole.
A fraction of a fraction of a group: the part of the whole.
A strip cut into equal parts, some of them shaded: the fraction shaded, in its simplest form.
A fraction of an hour, a metre or a kilogram: the minutes, centimetres or grams it makes.
Two taps filling one tank, each alone in a known time: the part of it they fill together in an hour.
